method: Wrapped the real createInitialBattleState, applyHeroSkill, endPlayerTurn and triggerTeamFinisher exports during the temporary test.
Validated every returned state with isBattleStateCheckpoint and its mission, frozen heroes, doctrine, difficulty, stance, pressure, bond support and tactical mode context.
Ran the existing runPlaytestAudit(204) unchanged through the wrapped engine.
Added all 16 Raon-containing deployments of 4 to 6 heroes across 8 missions, 3 difficulties and 2 doctrines.
The additional scenarios cycled the three stances and war pressure values 75, 85 and 100, with bond support 0 or 100.
limitations: Deterministic tactical engine validation, not browser gameplay or a visual/interaction test.
This run checks tactical BattleState acceptance; it does not independently verify browser storage I/O, slot switching, action-scene timing or the entire CampaignBattleAttempt wrapper.
The stress fixture cycles stance, pressure and bond settings rather than taking the full Cartesian product of those modifiers.
No normal state rejection was observed in the exercised paths; this does not prove all possible action sequences are covered.
integrationNotes: Temporary fixtures are in the ignored .tmp directory.
The fixture does not use a *.test.* filename and is selected only by its dedicated Vitest config.
No additional production fix was needed based on this run.
